notes.note: Reviewed the merged scheduler delta: retains conversation-run handoff and fatigue reconciliation before ledger claims, plus main automation polling independent of scheduler storage. The post-merge correction restores the existing errorMessage import used only when the poller rejects; no API/config/default/starter-work behavior changes. Existing scheduler ownership, bounded polling and run contracts remain accurate. 54 targeted fatigue/dispatch/GitHub-poll tests and scoped server-test typecheck passed. This review covers the error-normalization import and composition, not live provider qualification.
